full_i2s_counter_interpretation.six_error_frames: Fixture deliberately supplies six TF packets with a mismatched rate; each error frame must be a tagged zero and match the final-PCM oracle.
full_i2s_counter_interpretation.five_faults: Expected stopped-clock, media timeout and sticky owner6/DSP-fence isolation/recovery scenarios; the test fails if invalid output or incomplete isolation is observed.
full_i2s_counter_interpretation.analysis_and_record_drops: Consumers deliberately deassert ready using sequence modulo 3 and modulo 5; loss/error notifications are checked. These are separate from the realtime serial stream.

summary.decision: No actionable functional defect found in reviewed tag-RAM prototype.
summary.scope: Source review plus independent Icarus functional simulation only.
summary.oracle: Explicit per-case due-cycle FIFO and behavioral unsigned division by 147; no valid-shift or ring-address model.
limits: No synthesis or physical RAM inference acceptance.
No P&R, CLK-to-DO/STA, CDC, hardware, SRAM or Flash acceptance.
No per-owner routing failure attribution from FD aggregate diagnostics.

isolated_mapping.limits: Only isolated WIDTH42/TAG161 synthesis. It proves helper mapping, not whole-design physical BSRAM/CLS totals, route improvement or timing; oscillator attack was not independently mapped in this experiment.
